import unittest
from ledger.invoice import invoice_total, invoice_text
from ledger.money import to_cents


class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_to_cents_basic(self):
        self.assertEqual(to_cents(19.99), 1999)
        self.assertEqual(to_cents("0.285"), 29)

    def test_invoice(self):
        s, t, g = invoice_total([(19.99, 3), (4.35, 2)], 8.25)
        self.assertEqual(s, 6867)
        self.assertEqual(t, 567)
        self.assertEqual(g, 7434)

    def test_text(self):
        self.assertEqual(invoice_text([(1.10, 3)], 10), "subtotal 3.30 tax 0.33 total 3.63")
